# Fluid Dynamics

> > A showcase of 3D fluid simulation tutorials and demonstrations using RealFlow, Phoenix FD, and 3D Studio Max.

This site features tutorials, demonstrations, and project showcases for creating realistic liquid and water simulations in 3D Studio Max. It covers professional fluid dynamics tools including RealFlow (with Hybrido solver), Phoenix FD, and rendering engines like V-Ray, Maxwell Render, and Mental Ray.

## Key Topics

- 3D Studio Max
- RealFlow
- Phoenix FD
- Fluid simulation
- Water simulation
- Liquid dynamics
- Hybrido solver
- V-Ray rendering
- Maxwell Render
- Mental Ray
- Foam particles
- Splash effects
- 3D animation
- Particle simulation
- Rigid body dynamics

## Getting Started

- [Fluid Dynamics](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com): Homepage for 3D Studio Max fluid dynamics simulations and tutorials
- [3D Studio Max Fluid Dynamics](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/3d-studio-max-fluid-dynamics): 3D Studio Max fluid dynamics overview with Phoenix FD and V-Ray
- [RealFlow](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow): RealFlow 5 fluid simulation overview with Hybrido and Maxwell Render

## Tutorials

- [Phoenix FD Tutorial for Liquid Basic Setup](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/phoenix-fd-tutorial-for-liquid-basic-setup): Phoenix FD basic liquid setup tutorial for 3D Studio Max with V-Ray
- [3D Studio Max – Water Simulation Tutorial](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/3d-studio-max-water-simulation-tutorial): 3D Studio Max water simulation tutorial using Realflow
- [Rigid Body & Fluid Dynamics](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/rigid-body-fluid-dynamics): Rigid body and fluid dynamics simulation tutorial for 3D Studio Max

## Water and Ocean Simulations

- [Realflow 5 – Splash and Foam](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-5-splash-and-foam): RealFlow 5 ocean splash and foam simulation using Hybrido solver
- [Realflow Waterfall](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-waterfall): Realflow waterfall simulation using Hybrido and Maxwell rendering
- [Realflow Water Simulation](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-water-simulation): RealFlow water particle simulation in 3D Studio Max
- [Phoenix FD – Vortex in a Pool](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/phoenix-fd-vortex-in-a-pool): Phoenix FD pool vortex simulation with foam particles in 3D Studio Max
- [Realflow 2012 – Killer Whale](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-2012-killer-whale): Realflow 2012 killer whale fluid simulation demo with 3D Studio Max

## Splash and Foam Effects

- [Realflow Splash](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-splash): Realflow water splash simulation rendered with V-Ray
- [Splashes](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/splashes): Phoenix FD water splash simulation demonstration in 3D Studio Max
- [Realflow Foam](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-foam): RealFlow foam simulation demo for 3D Studio Max
- [Liquid and Foam](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/liquid-and-foam): 3D Studio Max liquid and foam simulation demonstration video

## Liquid Pouring and Product Simulations

- [Realflow Glass Simulation](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-glass-simulation): RealFlow glass liquid simulation using 3D Studio Max
- [Realflow Cream Pouring](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-cream-pouring): RealFlow cream pouring liquid simulation with Mental Ray rendering
- [Realflow Chocolate Donut](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-chocolate-donut): RealFlow chocolate donut liquid simulation with 3D Studio Max
- [Realflow Candy Bar](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/realflow-candy-bar): RealFlow candy bar liquid dynamics simulation video
- [Water Conservation Services International](https://fluidynamics.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/water-conservation-services-international): Water simulation project for Water Conservation Services using Realflow
